title: ShipClassTable
description: Shape of one ship class file, e.g. data/ships/scout-s01.json. THE NUMBERS BELONG TO THE DESIGNER; this contract fixes only what a ship class is made of and the ranges outside which a value is not a balance choice but a broken simulation. Every value under `movement` is read by the server integrator (ADR-0010 section 2) and by the client's prediction of the same integrator, from the same file. 단위 접미사 규약: 모든 수치 필드 이름이 단위로 끝난다 (_m, _mps, _mps2, _deg_s, _deg_s2, _ms, _s, _hz, _t, _ly, _kib_s, _ticks). 스키마가 모든 필드를 명시 선언하므로 접미사는 propertyNames 패턴이 아니라 이 선언 자체가 강제한다. 데이터 테이블은 와이어 계약과 달리 실수(SI 단위)를 쓴다 (ADR-0009 section 2의 명시적 예외). 이 값들은 와이어를 왕복하지 않고 기동 시 한 번 읽히며, 튜닝하는 사람이 읽을 수 있어야 한다. 서버 내부 상태도 같은 SI f64라 변환이 없다.

id.description: Stable id, lower-kebab. Written into SHIP_SPAWNED.ship_class_id after the server upper-snakes it, so renaming it rewrites history (principle 5).

Movement.title: ShipClassMovement
Movement.description: Every field here is an input to ADR-0010 section 2. Changing one changes what both the server and the client compute, in the same tick, from the same file.

model.description: Flight model. assisted_6dof is the superset: setting both assist decelerations to 0 and flight_assist to false gives pure Newtonian flight with no new code.

max_speed_mps.description: Speed cap applied to |v| after integrating. No per-direction caps: on a rotating ship they make adjudication messy for no gain.

main_thrust_mps2.description: Acceleration along ship-local +Z at full forward thrust. Also the cap for the assembled local acceleration vector (diagonal clamp).

reverse_thrust_mps2.description: Acceleration along ship-local -Z at full reverse. Keep it well under main thrust or flying backwards becomes optimal.

lateral_thrust_mps2.description: Acceleration along ship-local +/-X and +/-Y at full deflection.

brake_decel_mps2.description: Velocity bled per second while the brake is held. Outranks both assists; only one damping applies per tick.

assist_linear_decel_mps2.description: Velocity bled per second when flight assist is on and no thrust is applied. This is where the feeling of inertia lives: small means a long coast.

assist_lateral_decel_mps2.description: Bleed applied only to the velocity component perpendicular to the current thrust direction. Low makes turning feel like ice, high kills drifting.

turn_rate_max_deg_s.description: Cap on the attitude slew rate toward the aim quaternion.

turn_accel_deg_s2.description: How fast the angular velocity itself may change. Without it the ship reaches full turn rate instantly and feels robotic.

turn_gain_deg_s_per_sin_half.description: Proportional gain from attitude error to target turn rate, measured per unit of sin(theta/2). Deliberately expressed in sin(theta/2) and not in degrees: converting to an angle needs asin, and no transcendental function may enter the integrator (ADR-0010 section 3).

turn_deadzone_sin_half.description: Below this attitude error the target turn rate is zero. Without it a parked ship jitters forever.

auto_level_rate_deg_s.description: Cap on the roll rate the assist uses to bring ship-local up back toward system up. Slower than manual roll on purpose: a fast auto-level reads as 'my ship is turning by itself'.

auto_level_deadzone_sin.description: Below this roll error, and also when the nose is nearly parallel to system up (no roll reference exists there), auto-levelling does nothing.

DerivedForReview.title: ShipClassDerivedForReview
DerivedForReview.description: NOT READ BY CODE. Values recomputed by QA from `movement` and compared, so that a silent retune of one number shows up as a contradiction instead of as a feel complaint three slices later (I-25: verification needs independent sources).

hull_radius_m.description: There is NO collision in p1-01. Used only for spawn clearance and for the nearest-ship distance metric.

ParkedStats.title: ShipClassParkedStats
ParkedStats.description: Verbatim GDD 6.1 stats, parked so nobody re-invents them. NO p1-01 code may read this block.
